projectDescription: A toolkit for scraping trade data from the Uzbekistan Stock Exchange (UZSE), building OHLCV candlestick data across multiple timeframes, and running Pine Script technical analysis indicators via the backtest-kit editor.
keyFeatures: Headless browser scraping of UZSE trade result pages using Playwright
HTML trade table parser with SHA1-based deduplication for idempotent imports
OHLCV candlestick builder supporting 11 timeframes (1m through 1d) from raw trade data
Gap-filling for intraday and non-trading days to produce continuous candlestick series
MongoDB-backed exchange adapter registerable with backtest-kit via addExchangeSchema
Pine Script indicator support through the backtest-kit editor (npm start)
Cross-platform batch fetch scripts for Linux (fetch.sh) and Windows (fetch.bat)
Docker Compose configurations for MongoDB, MinIO, and Redis
publicApiSurface: scripts/linux/fetch.sh (batch download+import from Feb 2018 to Apr 2026)
addExchangeSchema({ exchangeName, getCandles }) — backtest-kit exchange adapter
ICandleDto { symbol, interval, timestamp, open, high, low, close, volume }
ITradeDto { time, symbol, issuer, securityType, market, platform, tradePrice, quantity, volume, hash }
